test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A sum of money amounts to Rs. 767 in 3 years, and to Rs. 806 in 4 years on simple interest at 6% annum. What is the sum?
solution:
**Given:**

A sum of money amounts to Rs. 767 in 3 years, and to Rs. 806 in 4 years on simple interest at 6% annum.

**Calculation:**

Interest for 1 year = 806 - 767

⇒ 39

Interest in 3 years = 39 × 3

⇒ 117

So, sum = 767 - 117

⇒ 650

**∴ The sum is Rs. 650.**
